meta.note: v7j female astronaut (pink helmet, pink trim, narrow shoulders, one smooth bust plate, dark undersuit waist band, wide hips, ~6.6 heads, 1.7 m, ~27 pt tall = 95% of the male crew walker). Faces RIGHT (+x); flip with scale(-1,1) for left. Pivot = ground point under the feet; boots touch y=0 on every frame. _glow is ADD, same pivot/frames. Walk: 12 f @12 fps loop foot-locked: body advances frame_dx_pt (1 pt) per frame = 12 pt/s; stance foot planted in world space, swing foot lifts ~2.2 pt. Move the sprite by frame_dx_pt per frame, never at a free speed.
